updateTime.description: Date and time when this downlink datatake document was last updated

reportName.description: Name of the source mission planning report this downlink datatake was consolidated from

satellite_unit.description: Satellite unit that performed the downlink (e.g. S1A, S2B)

mission.description: Mission identifier derived from the satellite unit (e.g. S1, S2)

datatake_id.description: Identifier of the datatake being downlinked

expected_tiles.description: List of tiles expected from the datatake downlink (Sentinel-2)

effective_downlink_start.description: Effective start time of the downlink

effective_downlink_stop.description: Effective stop time of the downlink

acquisition_start.description: Start time of the acquisition being downlinked

acquisition_stop.description: Stop time of the acquisition being downlinked

station.description: Ground or geostationary station that received the downlink

downlink_absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number during the downlink

acquisition_absolute_orbit.description: Absolute orbit number of the acquisition

acquisition_relative_orbit.description: Relative orbit number of the acquisition

partial.description: Flag indicating whether the downlink is partial

observation_time_start.description: Observation start time of the associated datatake

delivery_stop.description: Time at which delivery of the downlinked data completed, derived from correlated acquisitions

from_sensing_to_delivery_stop_timeliness.description: Elapsed time from sensing to delivery stop in microseconds

ds_sensing_start_date.description: Sensing start date of the datastrip associated with the downlink

from_ds_sensing_to_downlink_stop_timelin.description: Elapsed time from datastrip sensing to downlink delivery stop in microseconds

ds_product_name.description: Name of the datastrip product associated with the downlink
